items.stem: Why does a manual, out-of-band change to infrastructure managed by IaC cause problems?

options.text: It creates drift, so the real environment no longer matches the code and state
options.rationale: Correct: out-of-band changes cause drift that can break later applies and reproducibility.

options.text: It permanently deletes the IaC tool
options.rationale: A manual change does not remove the tool.

options.text: It makes the code run faster
options.rationale: Speed is unrelated; the issue is drift.

options.text: It has no effect because IaC ignores reality
options.rationale: IaC compares to real state, so the change does matter.

items.explanation: Correct: out-of-band changes cause drift that can break later applies and reproducibility.

items.stem: Which two practices keep secrets safe when using infrastructure as code? (Select TWO)

options.text: Storing secrets in a dedicated secrets manager referenced at apply time
options.rationale: Correct: a secrets manager keeps secrets out of the repo and controls access.

options.text: Keeping secrets out of the version-controlled configuration files
options.rationale: Correct: secrets committed to a repo are exposed to everyone with access.

options.text: Hard-coding the production password in the main config file
options.rationale: Hard-coded secrets in the repo are a serious exposure.

options.text: Emailing the secret to the whole team for convenience
options.rationale: Broad distribution by email increases exposure.

items.explanation: Correct: a secrets manager keeps secrets out of the repo and controls access.; Correct: secrets committed to a repo are exposed to everyone with access.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of reviewing the plan (proposed changes) before applying IaC?

options.text: To see exactly what will change and catch unintended or destructive actions first
options.rationale: Correct: plan review surfaces unintended changes before they reach the environment.
A plan does not freeze anything; it previews changes.
Plans show intended changes, not random values.

options.text: To delete the state file safely
options.rationale: Plan review is not about deleting state.

items.explanation: Correct: plan review surfaces unintended changes before they reach the environment.
